facts.fact: The higher-education ministry reports that its minister chaired the sixth multisectoral meeting on tracking implementation of Algeria's national AI strategy.
The ministry reports that thematic commissions built around the strategy's main axes presented their progress at the sixth multisectoral meeting on implementing the strategy.
